name: After Article 1
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Decision (EU) 2015/1814 as regards the market stability reserve for the buildings, road transport and additional sectors
part_text: Amendment Article 1(a) In Article 3 of Decision (EU) 2015/1814, the following paragraph is added: ‘The review of the market stability reserve for buildings, road transport and other sectors shall in particular assess the evolution of allowance prices, consumer prices, heating and mobility costs, the impact on competitiveness and small- and medium-sized enterprises, regional disparities, energy and mobility poverty and the interaction with existing national measures. The review shall also assess whether price stability mechanisms suffice for preventing disproportionate cost increases. Where significant adverse economic or social impacts are identified, the Commission shall assess the need for legislative action in relation to the emissions trading system for buildings, road transport and additional sectors and submit a legislative proposal to the European Parliament and to the Council to that effect.’;
